## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Classifier, reference cases, and conformal set support Normal with 0% invasive risk (tier 4) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 96%, InSitu 3%, Benign 1%, Invasive 0% | Strong Normal preference; 0% risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 99% reliability, 8% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical image; passes QC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (92%–95% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 9) · ↓ invasive · Contribution -1.99 [F2], but unreliable concept (0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 3, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score 1.58 (contribution -1.22) pushes against invasion [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 5) · context · Below-typical score -0.55 (contribution +0.94) [F4]; 8/20 spot check · Weak
- **HoVer-Net nuclei counts** (regions 6, 8, 11) · context · Insufficient tumor nuclei (1 neoplastic, 0 epithelial, 17 connective) · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); top concept `normal_lobules` is unreliable (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal InSitu (3% probability; contrast case BACH_0043, 76% similarity) or invasion (regions 6, 10) is missed.
- Unsampled regions contain atypia; HoVer-Net checked only regions 6, 8, and 11 (1 neoplastic nucleus in 6).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 8, 10**: Check highest risk (8, 6), invasion scores (6, 10), and neoplastic nucleus (6).
2. **Regions 3, 7, 9**: Verify normal lobules directly (`normal_lobules` concept is unreliable, 0/20 spot check).
3. **Regions 4, 5**: Inspect region 4 for duct-confined cells and region 5 for lymphocytes.
